change: price the Cyber 1.3 lab at 24, so a student's lab work shows as points and counts in the lesson total instead of printing a bare percent
_reported: Tanner, 2026-09-09, from his own gradebook: "29% not 7/24". The 1.3 Lab cell read 29%* while every other cell in that row showed a points pair, and 29 percent of 24 is 6.96, which rounds to the 7 he expected.
_root_cause: '1.3|lab' was in NEITHER table in scripts/seed-cyber-denominators.js: not priced, and not parked in MEASURED_UNPRICEABLE with a blocker either. Just absent. An unpriced column keeps its percent, is marked provisional and is left OUT of the points total, so the 1.3 row read 12/53 with the lab excluded while the unit percentage counted it.
_evidence_for_24: Read from the page that owns the activity, which is the rule this seeder states about every value it holds. /pages/ap-cyber-unit-1-lesson-3-lab carries 0 / 24 pts in its #labDone panel. Same shape and same number as '1.4|lab', whose comment already reads "labTotal sums all parts, rendered / 24 pts".
_the_guard_was_asserting_the_bug: smoke/cyber-denominators.js pinned lesson 1.3 at THREE priced columns, so the missing lab was not merely uncaught, it was required. The comment ten lines above it describes this exact failure about 1.1 lab: "in NEITHER table, which is the quietest way for a column to go missing". A bare count of what was authored on the day cannot tell "all of them" from "all the ones we happened to write down". It asserts the four column names now.
